::: proof

Entry-wise, for $i = 1, \ldots, p$:

$$
\ba
\sb{\deriv{\vx} (\vecf{a} \cdot \vecf{b})}_i
&= \deriv{x_i} \sumto{k}{p} a_k b_k \\
&= \sumto{k}{p} \paren{b_k \deriv{x_i} a_k + a_k \deriv{x_i} b_k} \\
&= \sb{\paren{\deriv{\vx} \tp{\vecf{a}}}\vecf{b}}_i
  + \sb{\paren{\deriv{\vx} \tp{\vecf{b}}}\vecf{a}}_i
\ea
$$

:::
